name: plugins
description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
one_liner: A collection of official add-ons for the Cursor AI coding tool that connect it to other developer services and tools.
buyer: No direct buyer — this is free, official developer tooling from Cursor, not a product anyone pays for on its own.
business_use_cases: A SaaS tool vendor builds an official plugin here so Cursor users can control their product directly from their AI coding assistant.
A dev tools startup studies the plugin spec to build their own Cursor integration as a growth channel for their product.
An enterprise dev team writes an internal plugin so their AI coding assistants can query internal company tools.

money_ideas.idea: No direct revenue from the repo itself; the business value is building a paid product elsewhere and shipping a free plugin here as a distribution channel

steal_this: If you already have a dev tool or SaaS, ship an official Cursor plugin this weekend purely as free distribution and lead-gen into your paid product.
